tools.name: vultr_list_region_plan_availability

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "vultr_list_ssh_keys" references sensitive artifacts (ssh key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: List the SSH keys stored on the account, with name and date created. Vultr API: GET /v2/ssh-keys.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: vultr_get_account · Private data: vultr_list_ssh_keys, vultr_list_dns_records, vultr_list_databases, vultr_get_database · Public sink: vultr_get_account · Destructive: vultr_list_region_plan_availability.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: vultr_get_account · Private data: vultr_list_ssh_keys, vultr_list_dns_records, vultr_list_databases, vultr_get_database · Public sink: vultr_get_account · Destructive: vultr_list_region_plan_availability

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
